This policy explains how Cymbal Corp employees earn and use paid time oﬀ (PTO) and the
other types of paid leave the company provides. It applies to all regular full-time
employees worldwide. Part-time employees accrue PTO pro rata based on scheduled
hours. Where local law provides a more generous entitlement, local law preva

PTO is a single bank of paid days that covers vacation, personal time, and short illnesses.
PTO accrues each pay period from the employee's ﬁrst day of employment. Annual accrual
depends on continuous years of service:

Once the bank reaches its maximum balance, accrual pauses until PTO is used. Employees
should request PTO in Workday at least two weeks in advance for absences of three or

(for example, ﬁscal quarter close for Finance).

3. Carryover and Payout
Up to 5 days of unused PTO may be carried over into the next calendar year. Carried-over
days must be used by March 31 or they are forfeited. Unused accrued PTO is paid out at
termination only where required by local law.
4. Company Holidays
Cymbal Corp observes 11 paid company holidays per year in the United States, published
each December in the Holiday Calendar. Other countries follow the local holiday

each December in the Holiday Calendar. Other countries follow the local holiday calendar.
Company holidays do not reduce the PTO bank.
5. Parental Leave

Cymbal Corp supports employees who are welcoming a child through birth, adoption, or
foster placement. Parental leave is separate from, and in addition to, the PTO bank.

the leave period, regardless of gender. The secondary caregiver is the other parent or

6. Bereavement Leave
Employees receive up to 5 paid days following the death of an immediate family member
(spouse or partner, child, parent, sibling, grandparent, grandchild, or the same relation by
marriage). Up to 2 paid days are provided for the death of another relative or close
friend. Bereavement days do not need to be consecutive but

of the loss.
7. Other Paid Leave
Jury duty: Full base pay for up to 10 days per calendar year.
Volunteer time oﬀ: 2 paid days per year for approved charitable activities.
Sabbatical: 4 weeks of paid leave after 10 years of continuous service, to be
scheduled with manager approval.

Remote Work and Equipment Stipend FAQ
Reference No. HR-FAQ-220 · Updated February 2026 · Owner: Workplace Experience & IT Security
Hybrid and Remote Work
Q: How many days per week can I work from home?
A: Hybrid employees are expected in the oﬃce 3 days per week (Tuesday to Thursday by
default) and may work from home on the other 2 days. Fully remote roles are designated
in the job oﬀer and approved by the department head.
Q: Can I work from a diﬀerent city in my h

and approved by the department head.
Q: Can I work from a diﬀerent city in my home country?
A: Yes. Domestic temporary remote work from any location in your home country is
allowed with manager approval, as long as you remain reachable during your core working
hours.
Work From Anywhere (International)
Q: Can I work remotely from another country?
A: Yes, under the Work From Anywhere (WFA) program. Eligible employees may work from
outside their home country for up to 20 workdays per calendar year

may work from
outside their home country for up to 20 workdays per calendar year. Days do not need
to be consecutive. Weekends and company holidays do not count toward the 20-day limit.
Q: What approvals do I need for international WFA?
A: You need (1) your manager's approval and (2) IT Security approval. Submit an IT
Security ticket of type SEC-WFA-99 at least 10 business days before you travel. IT
Security conﬁrms that the destination is not on the restricted-country list and that your
laptop

that the destination is not on the restricted-country list and that your
laptop meets encryption and VPN requirements.
Q: Are any countries excluded?
A: Yes. WFA is not permitted from countries under trade sanctions or on the IT Security
restricted list, which is published on the intranet and reviewed quarterly. WFA is also not
permitted in countries where Cymbal Corp has no legal entity if the stay would exceed 20
workdays, because of tax and immigration risk.
Q: Can I combine WFA with vacation

orkdays, because of tax and immigration risk.
Q: Can I combine WFA with vacation?
A: Yes. You can take PTO before, during, or after a WFA period. PTO days are not counted
as WFA workdays, but they must be requested separately in Workday and come out of
your PTO balance.
Q: What happens if I exceed 20 WFA days?

A: Any extension beyond 20 workdays needs written approval from your VP and from
Global Mobility, and may require a work permit. Unapproved extensions may result in
disciplinary action.
Equipment and Stipends
Q: Is there a home oﬃce stipend?
A: Yes. Hybrid and remote employees receive a home oﬃce equipment stipend of $1,000
every 3 years for items such as a desk, ergonomic chair, monitor, or headset. Submit
receipts on Form EXP-405 under the category "Home Oﬃce Equipment." Unused amounts
do not

on Form EXP-405 under the category "Home Oﬃce Equipment." Unused amounts
do not carry over to the next 3-year cycle.
Q: Is my internet reimbursed?
A: Employees who work from home at least one day per week can claim up to $50 per
month for home internet.
Q: Who provides my laptop?
A: IT provides a company laptop. Company laptops must be used for all work, must stay
connected to the corporate VPN when on public or foreign networks, and must not be left
unattended in public places. Report lost or s

ign networks, and must not be left
unattended in public places. Report lost or stolen devices to IT Security within 24 hours.

and Data Privacy
Policy No. SEC-POL-401 · Version 5.2 · Effective January 1, 2026 · Owner: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
1. Governance, Standards, and Regulatory Mandate
This policy establishes cybersecurity standards for all Cymbal Corp hardware, network infrastructure, data repositories, and
digital communications. Cymbal maintains certified compliance with SOC 2

s, and
digital communications. Cymbal maintains certified compliance with SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and adheres strictly
to international data privacy statutes including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California
Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
2. Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) & Endpoint Controls
Employees authorized to access enterprise email, Slack, or documents via personal devices must strictly comply with
mandatory endpoint hygiene rules:
  Google Workspace MDM En

trictly comply with
mandatory endpoint hygiene rules:
  Google Workspace MDM Enrollment: Personal mobile devices and laptops must be enrolled in Google Workspace
 Advanced Endpoint Management.
 Containerized Work Profiles: Corporate data must reside inside an isolated Work Profile. Cymbal retains the right to
 execute a selective remote wipe of the corporate container without wiping personal photos or applications.
 Full Disk Encryption: Hardware storage encryption must remain activated at al

 Full Disk Encryption: Hardware storage encryption must remain activated at all times (FileVault on macOS, BitLocker with
 TPM on Windows).
 Screen Inactivity Lock: Automated screen lock required after a maximum of 5 minutes of inactivity.
